tokenName: Securities Exchange Community Grain Receipt Token
underlyingAsset: Certified community grain and produce deposits — Pakistan
description: Securities Exchange lists tokenised warehouse receipts from smallholder farmers and rural cooperatives in Pakistan. Any farmer with certified stored produce can list their receipt on this exchange, attracting institutional buyers and creating immediate liquidity for rural communities. Minimum lot size is 1 bag of produce.
regulatoryFramework: Pakistan Warehouse Receipts Act; Securities Exchange Commodity Listing Rules

tokenName: Securities Exchange Digital Service Contract Token
underlyingAsset: Tokenised gig and informal service contracts — Pakistan
description: Service workers, artisans, freelancers and gig economy participants in Pakistan can tokenise their service contracts on Securities Exchange. Each token represents a verified contract, enabling service workers to attract working capital financing from investors. Electricians, tailors, plumbers and IT contractors all benefit from this financial inclusion instrument.
regulatoryFramework: Pakistan Financial Markets Act; Pakistan Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Securities Exchange Public Works Employment Token
description: Listed on Securities Exchange, this PPP contract token finances public infrastructure in Pakistan — roads, schools, hospitals and clean water. Token holders receive revenue-sharing distributions while simultaneously supporting national employment creation.
regulatoryFramework: Pakistan PPP Act; Public Works Employment Tokenisation Policy

description: Anyone in Pakistan with as little as one unit of local currency can co-own affordable housing through Securities Exchange. regulatoryFramework: Pakistan Financial Markets Act; Pakistan Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Securities Exchange Daily Labor Proof Token

regulatoryFramework: Pakistan Labour Act; Informal Economy Tokenisation Framework 2024
